items.statement: Executed molecular evidence supports substantial differential productive reactivity for the mapped substrate configurations.
items.expected: Connect the two valid stereochemical models to their relative facility; the author model has TS20-a below TS20-b. Its 8.6 kcal/mol common-reference separation supports discrimination in this model. It does not imply exactly zero reaction of the higher pathway, an absolute configuration without mapping, a global rate-determining assignment, or a quantitative prediction of the experimental endpoint ee. An alternative mechanism must carry its own relevant executed evidence; it does not turn missing numerical results into completed results.

items.statement: Separate-condition configurational-interconversion results have a limited, evidence-defined relationship to the catalytic observations.
items.expected: Establish both isolated-molecule barriers with their own minima, solvents and temperatures, then state the limits of connecting them to the public time-course and stability observations. Their numeric ordering across conditions does not establish a same-condition kinetic ordering. In particular these data do not prove rapid S interconversion during the 36 h reaction or close a quantitative DKR model. No coordinated-interconversion calculation, full catalytic network or precise endpoint ee is mandatory. The source author interpretation remains a hypothesis; a demonstrated limit on it is a valid bounded conclusion when grounded in computed results.
